mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_bookmark (member_id, post_id, regi_date) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{postId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM board_bookmark WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.*, bm.regi_date FROM board b JOIN board_bookmark bm ON b.post_id = bm.post_id WHERE bm.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY bm.regi_date DESC

SELECT b.post_id AS postId, b.title AS title, b.content AS content, b.created_date AS createdDate, b.view_count AS viewCount, b.sub_category AS subCategory, c.category_name AS categoryName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_like bl WHERE bl.post_id = b.post_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_reply br WHERE br.post_id = b.post_id) AS replyCount FROM board_bookmark bm JOIN board b ON bm.post_id = b.post_id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE bm.member_id = #{memberId} AND b.deleted = 0
AND (b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY bm.regi_date DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{amount}
